title: Stringy invariants for abelian character varieties
summary: We compute all stringy invariants, encoding orbifold cohomology numbers, of (the normalization of) the identity component of $G$-character varieties of free abelian groups and of moduli spaces of $G$-Higgs bundles on abelian varieties, for all complex connected reductive groups $G$. As an application, we provide a direct proof of a topological mirror symmetry statement: the equality of the stringy invariants for Langlands dual groups.
